{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it truly string with commas?
print("First 5 values of `revenue`:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for commas
print("\nAny commas in `revenue`?")
print(sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Check for non-numeric characters
print("\nNon-numeric characters in `revenue`?")
print(sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.isnumeric().all())"}
